It does not check `[OOS]` title prefix, per-item staleness, blocked remaining items, or membership in the run's stale-only closure list. A mistaken `--issues` value could close a live actionable issue while the helper reports success.
**Reason not implemented**: Voted out 0 YES / 3 NO (dismissed). The `close_stale_main` helper is invoked only after explicit operator approval from a prompt-driven gate (`oos-4`), so the closure set has already been human-verified. Adding a mechanical `[OOS]` prefix gate here would block valid stale closures where the prefix is absent; the plan scope intentionally relies on the approval gate rather than a redundant prefix check.
